customerOutcome: Confirm the exact previously submitted Native workflow request after a lost acknowledgement or page return, without creating another operation.
entryConditions: The customer UI requires the current authenticated account and selected company; Native current role, permissions and Original retained revision/run Sources mediate each read.
The Original request journal must belong to this exact company, workflow, operation, initiating principal and request UUID. A later request cannot replace it.
Read-only recovery remains mounted when workflow/builder/progressive rollout closes. Current Native permission and Source checks are still required.
exitConditions: An exact Native own-request receipt establishes only the historical recorded admission/publication/status change. It does not establish present workflow state, completed execution, physical Stop or independent verification.
Missing or refused receipts stay unconfirmed. No mutation, model, new request identity or execution is replayed by entry, reload or read retry.
Only a confirmed current-account/Source read clears the matching browser locator; a late, foreign or unavailable result retains it.

content.supportingCopy: Checking a saved request does not send it again. A missing response does not prove that no request was saved.
displayedState: Exact recorded operation and request reference; the recorded run link for Test/Run.
Historical publication revision or status change, explicitly separate from current workflow state.
Unconfirmed current read with explicit GET retry; raw errors and customer instructions are omitted.

inputs.label: I understand completed actions remain
inputs.help: On exact retained-run control only; Original revision/update/run identities are frozen by the client, not edited
inputs.validation: Must be explicitly checked; preserve one Original request identity before POST
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: None; held only in memory for the current account and Source

primary.label: Check the saved request
primary.operation: GET the exact Original own-request journal through its Native permission and Source owner.

destructiveOrIrreversible: The separate exact retained-run control requires current Native read/run permissions/write role and responsible-Human or Native company-administrator scope, exact workflow/revision/run/update review and completed-effects acknowledgement before one Original Stop POST. Admission does not prove physical termination.

canonicalReadDomains: Original workflow Activity request receipts and their exact retained workflow revision/run Source owners.
Current Native Human role, permissions and initiating account.
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: None. Confirmed browser reads may remove only their matched content-free per-tab locator.
systemWork.authorityEffect: A stored locator and navigation grant no authority. The Native owner repeats its actual current permission/role/Source checks. Request-snapshot instance-admin flags cannot substitute for the actual current Native role.
systemWork.asyncWork: The mounted read uses existing four-request/1500ms admission; unfinished underlying work retains its slot. Historical receipt transactions use PostgreSQL statement/lock limits and bounded two-row exact journal checks.
systemWork.receipt: Strict Test/Publication/Run/Status-change union containing only the Original immutable scoped receipt, without prompts, results, credentials or a claimed live qualification.

states.loading: Announce the current private read and withhold prior receipt while account, company or Source is unresolved.
states.empty: There is no successful empty/no-write state: a missing original receipt remains unconfirmed.
states.partial: Malformed, ambiguous, foreign or incomplete retained Source is unavailable; no partial receipt is rendered as confirmed.
states.stale: Withhold previous receipt during account/Source invalidation and reject a late prior response.
states.validation_error: Invalid company/workflow/kind/request locators are refused before fetching; invalid API query fields are rejected.
states.system_error: Show the safe unconfirmed message with explicit GET retry, without raw errors.
states.permission_denied: Keep receipt unavailable and its locator retained; do not grant authority from a request link.
states.recovering: Read only the exact Original own-request receipt. Automatic write retry or a fresh nonce cannot replace it. Existing explicit in-memory same-command retries retain their Original idempotency owner.
states.success: Show the historical immutable receipt under current Native read admission, then clear only the matching locator. Never claim current execution or independent verification.

navigation.back: Return to the exact Original workflow.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: No form or write exists on this page; leaving/reloading retains an unconfirmed content-free locator.
navigation.deepLink: Exact company/workflow/request kind/request UUID; this route is independent of new-work rollout gates. Retained run control is always mounted; navigation/language remain available after rollback.
navigation.resume: Before commands, retain per-tab company/account/workflow/kind/request UUID. Pending links on workflow entry survive rollout withdrawal rather than the old gate redirecting away.

accessibility.initialFocus: After confirmed current read, orient to the page heading through the utility-aware focus owner.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Use an announced safe alert and labelled read-retry control.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Focus the confirmed-request heading only if no existing utility/input/navigation gesture is active.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Ordinary labelled links and buttons; no canvas, drag gesture or node-type knowledge.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Loading/status and safe failure/alert are separate from historical success.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom common controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require exact-artifact 200/400% zoom/manual checks; bounded mobile/browser checks alone do not establish full conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animation. Fallback mobile navigation respects reduced motion.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Historical facts, request reference and recorded run link are ordinary text/link content; publication is not execution success.

responsive.wide: Constrained readable column with naturally wrapped content.
responsive.narrow: Wrap references and controls without horizontal scrolling.
responsive.mobile: Readable 390px layout with retained touch controls, language and fallback navigation after rollout withdrawal.

dataShown: The current authorized Original own-request receipt IDs and recorded disposition only.
Retained control selects only Native run/workflow/revision IDs, current status/purpose/update stamp. It does not query or restore private payload fields.
dataCollected: Per-tab bounded request locators written before Test/Publish/Run/Status POST. No command body, customer prose, input, result or credential is stored there.
sensitiveFields: No graph configuration, instructions, prompts, results, customer names, permissions or credential data is exposed.
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Entire workflow experience namespace, including empty/malformed scopes and refused methods, omits identity, object/request IDs, payloads and raw errors from generic logs.

prohibitedPayloads: Request identity, actor identity, prompts, customer prose, results, raw errors, URLs, DOM and screenshots

functional: Actual Native PostgreSQL reads for all four kinds after rollout withdrawal without new runs, revisions or audit events; exact own-source/current-permission/foreign-actor refusal.
API strict scope and aborted/foreign reply refusal; page current-account/Source withdrawal; locator-only reload and corrupt-storage refusal; preserved actual Native C0 browser test/recovery.

Native queued/waiting timer cancellation and copied-payload erasure, stale/viewer/non-manager refusal and late-role rollback are covered by software fixtures. Original cancellation-only recovery retains physical propagation after rollout closure; live child/provider termination and complete external outcome reconciliation/compensation remain open.

Private workflow Source erasure admits live-run cancellation through the Original owner. Exact-wait content-free cleanup metadata survives erasure and late results; Original cancellation-only recovery works with rollout closed, and actual Native queued child cancellation does not promote a replacement heartbeat. This is software evidence, not host/provider termination or external-effect compensation.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus, EN/DA and narrow layout against the actual build. Manual assistive technology and full zoom evidence remain pending.
securityPrivacy: Original current account/permissions and retained Sources are required. Missing receipts cannot prove no prior admission.

No recovery GET executes work or creates a new request identity. Explicit known Native pre-effect refusals release only their exact tuple; conflict with an already recorded request is not absence proof.

Verify private subworkflow results retain current source authority through actual public ancestors and child removal; copied run/step/wait/review/activity payloads are erased and late/restore writes stay unavailable. Retained IDs supply no source-sharing or runtime grant.
usability: Representative exploratory/pre-registered confirmatory Human evidence remains required; software fixtures cannot supply it.
